text: Do not detect refusal-rule changes with a flag. Add an athena subcommand that applies the reading acceptance rules to a stored request and reading and prints accept or refuse with the reason. After checks pass, Athena runs that subcommand from both the base build and the candidate build over the last 50 real requests with accepted readings from records, and the replay result is the list of requests the candidate refuses that the base accepted. Every candidate gets the replay; when nothing changed the list is empty and costs no model call. Tests use fixture records, and one test builds a candidate-like rule change and shows the newly refused requests are listed.
